preconditions.description: The number of rows in the flag matrix is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of columns in the flag matrix is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The number of segments is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= flag[i][j] <= 1000000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each element in the flag matrix is a positive integer not exceeding 1000000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= segments[i][0] <= segments[i][1] <= m for i in range(q))
preconditions.description: For each segment, the left border l is less than or equal to the right border r, and both are between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of results is equal to the number of segments.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(1 <= result <= n * m for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 1 and n * m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == count_components(flag, segments[i][0] - 1, segments[i][1]) for i, result in enumerate(results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the number of components in the corresponding segment of the flag matrix.
